entries.title: Racing Lagoon
entries.definitive_edition: Original Japanese PlayStation release with English fan translation patch

emulation.notes: Use DuckStation with an owned Japanese copy and the English fan translation patch for the best English-language experience.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with optional emulator-side improvements; PocketStation features depend on setup support.

primary.version: Original Japanese release with English fan translation patch
primary.why: Racing Lagoon is a Japan-only PlayStation racing RPG with no official English release; the original PS1 game with the completed English fan translation patch is the most complete practical way for English-speaking players to experience it.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Japanese PlayStation copy with the English fan translation patch in DuckStation, or play the original Japanese disc on compatible hardware if you read Japanese.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Japan-only PlayStation release, compatible with PocketStation and playable with the later English fan translation patch.
all_releases.reason: primary: official original release and the base for the complete English fan translation route.

all_releases.fidelity: Japanese budget reissue of the same PlayStation game.
all_releases.reason: skip: same base game as the original release, not a higher-fidelity or more complete version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no official English version; the original Japanese PlayStation game is the official complete release, while the fan translation is the practical English-language route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, or English localization was identified; the English translation is an unofficial fan patch.
